title: Openness of the unrestricted fibre Cohen-Macaulay locus
statement: Let f:X→T be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. The set of y∈X for which the depth [def-weil-pbc-depth] of the local ring of the fibre X_{f(y)} at y [def-pc-scheme-fibre; def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] equals its ring Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] is open in X.

source.place: Tag 045U (1), (2), its affine openness input Tag 00RI, and Tag 00N8

proof.text: Cover the base by affine opens and then the inverse images by affine source opens. The flat locally finitely presented morphism on each such affine chart is a flat finitely presented ring map. Its fibres are of finite type over residue fields, hence locally Noetherian. The local ring at the point of a chart fibre agrees with the scheme fibre stalk.

For the flat finitely presented affine algebra, Tag 00RI gives an open fibre Cohen-Macaulay locus. In these Noetherian local fibre rings the self-module Cohen-Macaulay condition of Tag 00N8 is precisely that regular-sequence depth equals Krull dimension. Thus the depth-equals-dimension locus is open on every affine chart. The chart opens agree because the condition is a property of the fibre local ring; their union is the desired locus. This is also the argument of Tag 045U (1), (2). The empty source gives the empty open set.

proof_origin.place: Tag 045U (1), (2), following its affine input Tag 00RI; the depth formulation uses Tag 00N8.

lean.statement:
theorem isOpen_fibre_depth_eq_ringKrullDim
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] :
    IsOpen {y : X |
      (IsLocalRing.depth (R := (f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y))
        ((f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y)) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
          ringKrullDim ((f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y))}
